dataset: ReMID real multi-illumination RGB-D, complete author-published five-shard release
paper: LumiDepth: Stable Monocular Depth in Multi-illumination Scenes (ECCV2026)
role: external evaluation only; never used for training, hyperparameter selection or checkpoint selection
depth_mask_note: Native metadata defines finite(depth)>0 with zero invalid. Raw values above10m including65535-like readings are retained unchanged. Evaluation must declare one fixed range before looking at errors.
capture_identity_note: Numeric category/scene IDs restart across transport shards and visually differ; view_group includes shard. Physical room/location identities are not supplied. Conservative grouping merges repeated category/scene IDs for resampling, but does not prove independence.
lighting_note: Frame names are ordinal variant IDs, not calibrated illuminant chromaticities. RGBs are processed real camera images; exact camera ISP/white-balance state and physical illuminant RGB vectors are not provided.
